title: eludite.navigation.highlight_references input
description: Reference highlighting: highlight the symbol at `line`, `column` (or the caret) and its references in the document (`textDocument/documentHighlight`), as the editor does after the caret rests for 200 ms while `editor.highlightReferences` is on; with `navigate`, move the caret to the next or previous highlighted reference (Ctrl+Shift+Down, Ctrl+Shift+Up), wrapping around.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

navigate.description: Move to the next or previous highlighted reference instead of asking again.
